zh: 國防部通報1架共機及9艘共艦，國軍監控應處
en: Taiwan reports a Chinese military aircraft and nine warships; armed forces monitored the activity.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：Schiebel展示無人直升機空中釋放小型無人機、廈門航空簽約採購50架波音737 MAX 8，2031年起分批交付、俄軍機接近南韓鬱陵島，當局短暫發布避難警報
en: Aviation briefs: Schiebel demonstrates drone launch from airborne uncrewed helicopter; Xiamen Airlines signs for 50 Boeing 737 MAX 8 jets, with deliveries from 2031; South Korea briefly issues shelter alert on Ulleung Island as Russian aircraft approach

zh: 美國東岸風暴恐影響感恩節期間多座機場航班
en: US East Coast storm threatens Thanksgiving flights across major hubs.

zh: 伊拉克航空重新掛牌出售兩架滯留突尼斯 35 年的波音 747 客機。
en: Iraqi Airways reopens sale of two Boeing 747s parked in Tunisia for 35 years.

zh: 航空安全彙整：Wizz引擎問題等4起獨立事件
en: Safety roundup: A Wizz engine problem is among four independent incidents.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：北約將前進部署一架預警機 供波蘭使用、波音Everett廠製造的737據報納入生產證書、新加坡航空取消9條航線的空中巴士A350服務
en: Aviation briefs: NATO to forward-deploy one AWACS aircraft for use by Poland; Boeing's Everett-built 737s reportedly added to production certificate; Singapore Airlines cancels Airbus A350 service on nine routes

zh: JAC航機出現飛行控制故障指示；另有3起獨立事件
en: Four independent incidents include a JAC flight-control malfunction indication at Kagoshima.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：亞太永續航空燃料大會在新加坡登場 2030年目標佔比3%至5%、LATAM Airlines公佈A321XLR客艙設計 規劃搭載174名乘客
en: Aviation briefs: Sustainable aviation fuel conference opens in Singapore; 2030 share target is 3% to 5%; LATAM Airlines unveils A321XLR cabin design for 174 passengers

en: Taiwan CAA to open booking for second-wave island flights Nov. 24.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：芝加哥奧黑爾機場（ORD） E 候機廊動工 規劃新增 24 座登機門、西雅圖機場（SEA）登機空橋發生移民執法行動 阿拉斯加航空航班延誤
en: Aviation briefs: Chicago O’Hare breaks ground on 24-gate Concourse E; Alaska Airlines flight delayed after immigration arrests on Seattle jet bridge
